vb_textbox.text: On the first turn choose the gnome with the flat cap and keep choosing this gnome until the mushrooms gathered are 5 or less.Then change to the gnome with the pointy cap and keep choosing the same gnome until the mushrooms become 5 or less.  If both gnomes are below 5 then keep alternating between the 2 gnomes until the mushrooms gathered on one of them starts to increase.Then stick with this one until it returns to a low count then same again alternate between the 2 until one starts to increase and repeat until the end. Enjoy!
